ME - Millennium Station Lower-Level Depot Out of Service May 30-31, 2026

Due to planned work, Metra Electric trains will not have access to their normal boarding platforms at Millennium Station May 30-31 from 7am to 7pm. Trains will board from South Shore Depot tracks #8, #9, and #10. See Metra personnel for assistance.

RID - 115th Street Morgan Park Station Reconstruction

Beginning May 9, 2025, the 115th Street Morgan Park Station will be temporarily inaccessible to ADA users due to station reconstruction. Full site construction is expected to continue through Spring 2026. An accessible alternative is the 111th Street Morgan Park Station. Metra will provide updates once accessibility is restored.

ME - New Metra Electric Line Schedule, Effective June 15, 2026

Effective Monday, June 15, 2026, Metra will be expanding the Metra Electric line morning, midday, and evening inbound and outbound service. This will affect the Mainline, Blue Island, and South Chicago branch. For schedule information visit metra.com.

MD-N Grayslake Station Construction (UPDATE)

The east half of platform 1 (north platform) and the east stairway remains closed for continued rehab. The west half is closed also. Passengers must board trains near the pedestrian walkway. ADA access will not be impacted. Updates will be provided.

All trains will ground load at 111th, 107th, 103rd, 91st, 87th, 83rd, 79th, and 75th Street

All trains will ground load at 111th, 107th, 103rd, 91st, 87th, 83rd, 79th, and 75th Street. Do not operate chains or gates and follow the train crew's instructions after the train stops. Stations will not be ADA-accessible.

ME Beginning May 18 South Water Elevator Will Be Closed

Starting May 18, the South Water elevator will be closed during reconstruction. ADA passengers should use Van Buren St or Museum Campus/11th St for elevator access. For the latest service alert info visit Metra.com/MEelevators.

Due to construction, the east end of platform 2 (south platform) at Kedzie will be closed until the end of October. Please use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.

RI - New Rock Island Line Schedule, Effective June 1, 2026

Effective Monday, June 1, 2026, Metra will be expanding the Rock Island line weekday service from 80 to 84 trains and weekend service will expand to 40 trains on both Saturdays and Sundays. Visit metra.com for schedule information.
